# Milestone brief — ui-uplift-m12

**Title:** Corpus before machinery — reorder the detail page (v0)
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** ui-uplift (plans/ui-uplift/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-09-08 -> 2026-09-26

## Parent epic

- ui-uplift-e3 — Corpus before machinery — information architecture and live-region hygiene
  The papers table, the only corpus content on the detail page, begins at y=1823 of a 2343px document, after six consecutive input forms — an order that mirrors shipping history, not operator priority. This epic reorders the page around its primary object, adds the focal lede the page has never had, and fixes the live-region behaviour that currently announces every 2 seconds for a whole ingest run.

## Summary

UPL-1. Lead with identity, state and the papers table; collapse the five mutation forms into one native <details> below the corpus. Converts a measured 1823px scroll to the most common task into roughly one viewport. Detail page only in v0; the index half pairs with m11. Ships with NO expand animation — animating <details> needs interpolate-size or ::details-content, both Chromium-only, and the discovery run parked interpolate-size as too new without noticing its own motion primitive depended on it.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the detail page, when opened, then the papers table is visible without scrolling past any input form
2. Given a notebook with a non-terminal or failed ingest state, when the page renders, then the Manage disclosure is OPEN — the ingest fragment polls every 2s and would otherwise poll invisibly for a whole run
3. Given the disclosure summary, then it carries a state cue sourced from the same row the ingest fragment already reads
4. Given the five moved forms, then every hx-target still resolves and no swap silently lands out of view
5. Given the reorder, then NO expand animation is claimed or budgeted for

## Depends on

- ui-uplift-m8 — Retire .card; adopt the graded hairline rule ladder [status: planned]
